resources.string: Detects when a protected app opens

AppLock needs this to notice the moment a protected app comes to the foreground, so it can show the lock screen before any of that app\'s content is visible.\n\nIt reads only the package name of the app being opened. It does not request permission to read screen content, so it cannot see text, passwords or anything you type.
A silent, permanent notification Android requires while AppLock is guarding your apps.
Tap to change which apps are locked
